source_evolution: EVO22 local ZIP tail ABI preflight pilot; this is a separate bounded tool-development package, not a new reflection or promotion

target.source: G292 frozen official page/HEAD candidate; no APK bytes yet

mechanism: Explicit --probe-g292 only: pinned HTTPS host/path, verified TLS, HEAD identity, exact tail Range with If-Range, EOCD and bounded central-directory Range, 206+exact Content-Range/length/strong ETag/no content encoding drift. No redirect handling and never a full GET. ZIP64, multi-disk, malformed, changed validator, ignored Range or over-budget directory yields UNKNOWN_FALLBACK. Positive ABI/no-native only says continue full GET checks; raw_admitted always false.

byte_budget.wire_limit_caveat: Application read plus accounted headers is capped below 1 MiB; HTTP/TLS may buffer bytes before close, so exact on-wire byte count requires external network accounting. No response body is read when server answers 200 to a Range request.

next: Independent review of code/fixture and byte-bound semantics before any explicit --probe-g292 network call; a positive preflight never bypasses complete APK hash, manifest and signer gates.
